title: Installation
subtitle: Get started with qortex-store
description: Install qortex-store for framework-agnostic state management.
content: Install qortex-store using your preferred package manager. Zero runtime dependencies.

sections.title: Install Package
sections.content: Add the package to your project:

code.code:
# npm
npm install qortex-store

# yarn
yarn add qortex-store

# pnpm
pnpm add qortex-store

sections.title: Requirements
sections.content:
• **Zero dependencies** — works everywhere
• **TypeScript** ≥ 4.7 recommended for full type inference
• For React bindings, see [qortex-store-react](/store-react)
